title: Cosmo: say what is starting the moment it starts
description: Cosmo's reply about a generation it started reached the chat only after the image landed: the reply was written two model rounds after the dispatch (a memory-nudged write_memory, then the reply), ~35 s each. Fix: the line saying what starts rides with the call and shows once the call passes the refusal race; the memory nudge no longer costs a round before the user hears anything.
